integrity: General asymptotics and centering are proved analytically; exact finite enumerations are supporting consistency checks. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent distance-decaying detection on a uniform finite path, with exactly two traps and certain detection at distance zero.
Optimizes average animal detection, not abundance-estimation efficiency, worst-site guarantee or correlated trap events.
The result is not empirically validated; other probabilistic facility-location literature could contain an equivalent result.

2002 prior work is separately cited for its exponential-kernel model; the first_public_date records the exact verified 2014-02-05 online publication date of the selected primary motivating ecological design source, not a claim about all related historical literature.
title: Noncommuting detection-range and landscape-size limits for two ecological traps
